page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge demonstrates stable mid-range performance. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1282.13 GB/sec, which drops to 109.43 GB/sec for large block uncached reads. For database operations, the instance handles 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a Passmark database operations score of 8647.45.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is positioned for general-purpose workloads requiring consistent compute performance without burst degradation. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, web serving with a static throughput of 17.13 GB/sec, and lightweight machine learning tasks, such as small-model LLM inference where it processes 1294.61 tokens per second for a 135M model. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for compute-heavy or memory-balanced applications that utilize external block storage.
